name: ForeignKeyMapping
summary: An association between objects, carried in the database as a foreign key.

roles.name: ForeignKeyMapping
roles.summary: A reference from one object to another that the mapper stores as a key column. Annotating it says where an association crosses into the schema, which is what makes the update order visible: the referenced row must exist first, and a cycle between two of these is a mapping that cannot be written in any order.
